description: This file contains the implementation of a remote dispatcher for services in the Apache OFBiz framework, enabling remote invocation of services over RMI with various execution modes such as synchronous, asynchronous, and scheduled calls.

classes.name: RemoteDispatcherImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the RemoteDispatcher interface, providing RMI-based remote invocations for OFBiz services, with support for synchronous, asynchronous, and scheduled execution modes.

methods.name: RemoteDispatcherImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the remote dispatcher with a local dispatcher, socket factories, and configures export settings.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously with the given context.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously with a specified transaction timeout and transaction requirement.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously but ignores the result.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously with specified transaction parameters, ignoring the result.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously with a requester, persistence, and transaction control.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously with a requester and persistence.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously with a requester.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously with persistence.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously with default parameters.

methods.name: runAsync
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously with context only.

methods.name: runAsyncWait
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously and returns a waiter object for the result.

methods.name: runAsyncWait
methods.description: Runs a service asynchronously with a context and returns a waiter object.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a service to run at a specified time with repeat parameters.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a service to run at a specified start time with repetition.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a service to run at a specified start time with interval and end time.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Schedules a service to run at a specific start time.

methods.name: checkExportFlag
methods.description: Checks if the service is marked for export based on configuration and throws exception if not.
